description: Template for recording Human‑in‑the‑Loop (HITL) interventions in AI systems.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: Identity of the human overseer or operator performing the intervention.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role or function of the actor (e.g. clinician, risk officer, engineer).

fields.name: decision_boundary
fields.description: Description of the permissible boundaries and constraints relevant to this decision.

fields.name: action_taken
fields.description: Specific intervention performed (e.g. approve, override, pause, adjust parameters).

fields.name: escalation_state
fields.description: Current escalation state (e.g. normal, warning, critical).

fields.name: stop_authority_trigger
fields.description: Whether the intervention triggered stop authority (true) or not (false).

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the intervention event.

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: Human‑readable explanation for the intervention, including reasons for override or escalation.

fields.name: intervention_result
fields.description: Outcome of the intervention (e.g. system paused, decision amended, alert escalated).

fields.name: additional_metadata
fields.description: Optional additional metadata (e.g. request identifiers, version numbers, contextual factors).
